# Technical Audit: Deterministic Bounded Event-Processing Service

## 1. Scope and Core Invariants

This audit examines a production design for a deterministic, bounded event-processing service. The system is composed of a ring-buffer queue, a sequence allocator, producer/consumer paths, a checkpoint writer, a recovery journal, a metrics collector, a backpressure controller, an ownership table, a timestamp recorder, a batch scheduler, network ingress, and a persistent manifest. warmups.label: warmup-2048
warmups.text:
# Technical Audit: Deterministic Bounded Event-Processing Service

## 1. Scope and Requirement De-duplication

The specification contains 70 numbered requirements, but only 20 are unique. Requirements 1–20 are repeated verbatim three additional times (21–40, 41–60, 61–70). The audit therefore evaluates 20 distinct invariants and their cross-cutting interactions. The repetition itself is a documentation defect: a traceability matrix keyed by requirement number will double-count coverage and mask gaps. Recommendation: renumber to R1–R20
